patch_description: This version uses two independent input-derived repair paths, keeping the better repaired-and-saturated graph rather than relying on one deletion trajectory. It then performs a stronger bounded exchange search using compact integer bitsets for very fast C4 legality checks. Saturation is dynamically degree-balanced: at every step it selects among currently legal missing edges with the smallest endpoint-degree score, preserving the nearly regular structure associated with dense C4-free graphs. All local-search candidates are produced only by deleting and re-adding edges from the supplied graph state, and every phase is explicitly verified using the common-neighbor characterization.
